description: Reduce LLM_TIMEOUT from 300s to 120s
rationale: Average LLM latency is 17.34s. A 300s timeout means a hung request blocks the bot for 5 minutes, causing user frustration and potential cascading timeouts. 120s is still generous (7x the average) but prevents indefinite blocking. This also reduces the window for resource waste during network issues.

This wastes Claude tokens (256 calls already) on tasks better suited to Palmyra. Removing these reduces false positives while keeping specific coding indicators like "traceback", "pytest", "docker".

description: Fix retry logic in llm_chat to catch non-ClientError exceptions during retry
rationale: The current retry loop only catches aiohttp.ClientError. If a retry throws a different exception (e.g., asyncio.TimeoutError, json.JSONDecodeError), it propagates uncaught, crashing the agent loop. Adding a broad except ensures all retry failures are handled gracefully, improving resilience.

description: Remove generic terms 'update' and 'write a' from CODING_PATTERNS
rationale: "update" matches non-coding requests like "update me on the status" and "write a" matches "write a summary" or "write a message". These cause false routing to the coding model. The remaining terms (edit, modify, rewrite, implement) are sufficiently coding-specific.
